findings.issue: The 200 ms search-debounce timer is never cancelled when the component unmounts. Type in the search box then click a Pokémon card within the debounce window and the pending goto('/?q=…', { replace: true }) fires on the new page, yanking the user back to the list.
findings.suggestion: Clear the timer on teardown, e.g. $effect(() => () => clearTimeout(timer)) or an onMount-style cleanup, and/or drop the pending goto if the component is no longer mounted.

findings.issue: Every module imports via a custom '#lib/*' package-imports alias instead of SvelteKit's built-in $lib alias; sv tooling, templates, codemods and future migrations all assume $lib.
findings.suggestion: Use $lib/server/api.ts etc. (SvelteKit's generated alias), or document why the Node subpath-import alias is preferred.

findings.issue: res.json() is not covered by the error handling around fetch/res.status, so a malformed API response becomes an unhandled rejection and a generic 500 instead of the deliberate 502/503 paths.
findings.suggestion: Wrap the body parse in the same try/catch and error(502, …) on failure.

findings.issue: Pagination hrefs are computed from current(), which blends URL state (type/generation/page) with the locally-edited search box value, so links can encode a query the URL doesn't have yet (e.g. type, then immediately click Next).
findings.suggestion: Build pagination hrefs from data (the committed URL state) plus data.q, not the unsubmitted local query.

findings.issue: The each-block key is `${row.name}-${row.level}-${i}`, appending the index; rows are already unique by name+level within a table (dedup happens in the load), so the index defeats Svelte's keyed reconciliation when sorting.
Every request re-derives typesById (24 type payloads) and re-sorts the 1025-entry species map; only the underlying fetches are cached, not the derived work.
findings.suggestion: Cache the derived typesById/species-index alongside the fetch cache (same TTL), or derive it once per TTL inside lib/server/api.ts.

findings.issue: The prepare script silences sync failures with `svelte-kit sync || echo ''`, which can hide real config errors during install.
findings.suggestion: Drop the `|| echo ''` fallback and let sync failures fail loudly.

summary: This is a well-crafted SvelteKit 3 app that is impressively current — vite-plugin config, explicit env vars, $app/state, snippets and the new goto options all match today's docs — with clean route/component decomposition and genuinely helpful comments. The one real defect is an uncancelled debounce timer on the home page that can hijack navigation after the user has left, plus a consistent $lib→#lib alias deviation that tooling won't understand. I'd merge after one small bug fix and a nits round.
